text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(Expectation, excitement, curiosity...
Everyone has their eyes fixed on my every move.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(The power each and every one of them holds—
all of it directed at me... If so——)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Gentildonna!
In this year's Japan Cup, a clash of true titans!
The victor is Gentildonna!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And right here, right now! A historical first!!
An Umamusume has achieved
consecutive victories in the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna... There's no doubt about it...!
She is the strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you for your cheers.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Every single note is proof.
Proof of the power I possess—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers echo in praise of the victor who achieved a great feat.
Here and now, Gentildonna proved herself
to be the "strongest" in the country—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
—...I see.
Gentil... pulled it off, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
"She truly is magnificent, as expected.
The pinnacle of the racing world—she will surely grasp the world in her hands as well."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
If that is so... then I should definitely use "that."
I shall bestow it upon you as a reward—
